items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And of course our principals, Lil Greenwood, Joya Sherrill, and Buddy Briggs.

ctx.x: That's why Duke called him Little Monster, right?

Yeah. He'd say, "Don't let him get away with that. Get what you need." And then Duke told me -- of course we had the Alvin Ailey Dancers, the Talley Beatty Dancers, and Irving Bunton Choir, and a big orchestra, you know. And of course our principals, Lil Greenwood, Joya Sherrill, and Buddy Briggs. Let's see, who else? I can't think of anybody. Well, it was quite a -- I think it was 196 --
